accrue-acc_acme.text: Acme Cloud is an enterprise customer at $180,000 ARR. Renewal is sensitive after 2026 reliability issues. Product usage is checkout API and webhooks.
Priya Shah, VP Engineering, is economic and technical buyer. Direct, evidence-first. Explicitly asked not to be offered credits after reliability failures.
Do not offer credits or discounts to Priya Shah in response to reliability incidents. She stated this on 12 Mar 2026.
Do not mention SSO unless Priya raises it. Q2 SAML SSO slipped to Q3; she was informed 2 Jun 2026 and it is a landmine in incident comms.
Standing commitment: dedicated P1 updates to Priya and Marcus within 15 minutes and a named engineering owner on the war-room thread (promised 18 Mar 2026).
Two P1s already this quarter: 11 Jul checkout API 5xx (41 min) and 19 Aug webhook timeouts (28 min). A third outage this quarter would match Priya's March 'we are done' threshold language.

accrue-acc_northstar.text: Comparable SAVE: Northstar Analytics — founder note within 2 hours + 48-hour dedicated war room with named eng owner after repeated API downtime. Discount was not the lever.

accrue-acc_helix.text: Comparable CHURN: Helix Commerce — 20% credit and a free month after a third reliability incident, without fixing root cause. Customer said credits are not uptime.

accrue-acc_brightpath.text: Comparable SAVE: Brightpath Health — engineering-first response, twice-daily written updates, no credits. CISO buyer treated money-as-apology as incompetence.

accrue-acc_orbit.text: Comparable CHURN: Orbit Logistics — repeated credits trained the customer that outages were expected.
